main_text.p: citationes prædictas interpolatas sub nomine Copernici Redivivi hic Leydæ ederet in materia de authoritate S. Scripturæ in Astronomicis totus alius prodiret: nec tantum omitteret ea quæ de authoritate sacra in differtationibus suis tam graviter & pie differuerat, sed suæ proprii pedibus concul-cans, ita invehitur adversus authoritatis sacra propugnatores Cop. Rediv. cap. 8.

Quod autem adversarii suas malefa-nas & absurdissimas opiniones harum (sacrarum scripturarum) authoritate palliare, & imprimis ex illis dogma inveteratum de immobilitate globi terreni probare satagant, valde improbo & tantum non indigne fero. Tantum mutatus erat Lipstorpius Cartesius a Lipstorpio pure Copernicano.

Habuimus unum exemplum rejectionis authoritatis sacræ in naturalibus & Astronomicis: sequitur alterum Antagonista nostri Wittichii, qui duas edidit Differtationes de usu & abusu scripturæ in Philosophia naturali, quibus intendit probare, S. Spiritum in scriptura nudam veritatem circa res naturales non velle manifestare

page.notes: Printed text is set in a larger roman with italic passages; several words are hard to read in the scan and are transcribed as printed, with the following doubtful readings: "Leydæ ederet" (as printed), "Lipstorpius", "Cartesius" and "Lipstorpio" are read from the print and may be misread. The page ends mid-sentence ("manife-" continues on the next page). The original lines of the first paragraph are set in italic throughout, and the last line is hyphenated.
